input.spec: Daily number guess. Players call guess(n) with no ETH; one guess per address per UTC day. After the day ends anyone calls settle(); a VRF random number picks the closest guess; the winner claims a prize paid from the game's balance (funded by GameFunder), capped at 0.01 ETH per day. Only the Safe can pause. Tests: fuzz guess and settle, invariant balance >= owed claims, fork simulation of 30 days.
Winner takes all: players deposit ETH into a shared pot with a payable join(); at the end of the hour one depositor wins the whole pot.
A quest board behind an upgradeable proxy whose admin is the agent key, so the rules can be improved after launch; it may also call FeeVault to redirect a share of fees to quest prizes.
A questions page on the site: plain answers to what DNA is, who decides what ships, and what the Safe can veto. Text and links to the site's own pages only; no wallet and no contract.

A fee module: the fee rises one step for a swap above a size threshold and two steps above four times it, never above its own cap. Pure math on the swap's size; no state, no calls. Tests: unit tiers, fuzz that a bigger swap never pays less, the module conformance suite.
